msg: Ignore the shape and size of the gnomes and focus on the colour.  You will have red vs brown and green vs purple.  At first, select any gnome.  If the score if 5 or more, continue choosing the same colour until the score drops to 4.  When this happens, switch to the other colour.  If that is also below 5, keep switching between the two until you get a score 5 or above again.  Once that happens, stick with that colour and repeat.
